launcher.notes: ANY NETWORK — fix for 'fail to download the forge universal jar': the two TLauncher-stack classpath jars are now ALSO committed to this repo (hosted/) and download through 5 independent mirrors (raw.githubusercontent → jsDelivr .pack alias → github.com/raw → release asset → official maven/TLauncher origin), every hop sha1-gated (dc0e4003… / d1f454ec…); corrupt jars auto-deleted and re-downloaded; bundled copy itself sha1-checked before use. Launch stack unchanged: byte-pure vanilla 1.8.9 client + official Forge 11.15.1.1764 universal + OptiFine HD U M5 (TLauncher's exact artifacts, token-exact args). Bundle: Kinetrix Client v3.3.8.

notes: Client 3.6.0 "Auras Reborn + True Account Sync": (1) account switching is now fully account-aware - equipped cape/pet/aura are stored PER MC ACCOUNT instead of one global file, so a different account no longer shows the old account's cosmetics; (2) the website profile sync can no longer answer with the old account's row after a switch (the linked-name fallback only applies while the MC session matches the login identity); (3) skins follow the database on switching - an account without a website skin drops the previous account's synced skin back to the vanilla/Mojang skin, and locally picked skins clear on switch; (4) the AURA cosmetics were REBUILT: no more 3 glow images orbiting the player - every aura is now a big glowing circle centred on the player (two counter-rotating themed rings) plus a themed particle field (rise / fall / orbit / spiral / burst); (5) 10 NEW auras: Emerald, Royal, Shadow, Solar, Rainbow, Vortex, Plasma, Cyclone, Blossom, Amethyst - 21 total, all with live previews in both cosmetics screens. Launcher/forge sections unchanged - existing launchers auto-update the client on next start.
